content.text: {"notes":["The requested forward_position and forward_velocity are world-frame quantities evaluated at the absolute time t=2.0 s; SI units are metres and metres per second.","The world coordinate convention is right-handed, with +x forward, +y left, and +z up.","The scheduled intervention starts at t=0.4761 s and continues through t=2.0 s; after onset, each axle uses zero-velocity braking with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m.","stopped_by_T is true only if absolute forward speed is below 0.02 m/s and planar speed is below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
